leaves.name: smoothGeomConnIntegral
leaves.doc: A smooth, geometrically connected scheme over a field is geometrically integral (smooth => geometrically regular => geometrically normal; connected + normal + locally noetherian => integral): Stacks Project, Varieties and Properties; EGA IV_2 4.5-4.6, 6.7-6.8 (printed form; locators UNVERIFIED)
leaves.source: Stacks Project (Varieties: smooth over a field is geometrically regular; Properties: normal, connected, locally noetherian is integral); EGA IV_2 4.5-4.6, 6.7-6.8 (locators UNVERIFIED)
